args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release with a healthy production track record — across all production regions.
3. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.
4. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate down to 0.2%.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. Follow-up is needed to root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before it's redeployed.
